EcommerceEnhanced.PluginDescription: GA4 ecommerce for Matomo: reads your GA4 dataLayer and records brands, variants, item lists, promotions, coupons, checkout steps and every shopping step, on top of the native Matomo ecommerce.
EcommerceEnhanced.SettingValueIncludesTaxAndShipping: The GA4 value includes tax and shipping
EcommerceEnhanced.SettingValueIncludesTaxAndShippingHelp: GA4 defines the purchase value without tax and shipping. Some shop extensions send the grand total instead. Check this box if yours does, so the Matomo revenue is not counted twice.
EcommerceEnhanced.SettingEventsReportTypes: Ecommerce steps shown in the Events report
EcommerceEnhanced.SettingEventsReportTypesHelp: Each step is tracked as an event with the category "Ecommerce", a readable action and the GA4 event name as the name. Unchecked steps are still recorded in the Ecommerce Enhanced reports.
EcommerceEnhanced.SettingNonInteractionTypes: Steps that do not count as an interaction
EcommerceEnhanced.SettingNonInteractionTypesHelp: These steps keep the visit alive but do not count as an action, so they do not lower the bounce rate. Viewing steps are checked by default, as in GA4.
EcommerceEnhanced.SettingItemCustomParamsHelp: Names of up to %1$s custom item parameters of your dataLayer to record, for example size or color. Only add names at the end of the list: each one keeps its position for good.
EcommerceEnhanced.SettingItemCustomParamsTooMany: At most %1$s custom item parameters can be recorded.
EcommerceEnhanced.SettingItemCustomParamsInvalid: "%1$s" is not a valid parameter name: use letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter, 40 characters at most.
EcommerceEnhanced.DeactivatedWarning: Ecommerce Enhanced is deactivated. Its data is kept, but while the plugin is deactivated, GDPR deletions and the deletion of old raw data no longer cover it. Activate it again to cover it.
EcommerceEnhanced.ShoppingBehaviorHelp: How many visits reached each shopping step, as in the GA4 shopping and checkout behavior reports. Steps are counted in any order, without the Funnels plugin.
EcommerceEnhanced.MerchandisingHelp: Products, brands, variants, item lists and promotions: how often items were seen, added to cart and bought, from the GA4 ecommerce events of your site.
EcommerceEnhanced.OrderDetailsHelp: Orders and revenue by coupon, payment type, shipping tier, customer type, affiliation and currency, as sent with the GA4 purchase event.
EcommerceEnhanced.ShoppingBehaviorDocumentation: Visits that reached each step: any visit, a product view, an add to cart, a checkout and a purchase. The step rate compares each step to all visits, the abandonment rate shows the visits lost before the next step.
EcommerceEnhanced.CheckoutBehaviorDocumentation: Visits that reached each checkout step: begin checkout, shipping info, payment info and purchase. The abandonment rate shows the visits lost before the next step.
EcommerceEnhanced.ProductsDocumentation: Each product with the number of times it was viewed, added to cart and bought, its revenue and its conversion rates. Unlike the native Products report, views and adds to cart come from the GA4 events.
EcommerceEnhanced.BrandsDocumentation: Each brand with the number of times its products were viewed, added to cart and bought, and their revenue.
EcommerceEnhanced.VariantsDocumentation: Each product variant (product name, then variant) with its views, adds to cart, purchases and revenue. The native ecommerce merges variants sharing a SKU, this report keeps them apart.
EcommerceEnhanced.ItemListsDocumentation: Each item list (category page, search results, related products...) with its views and clicks, and the items added to cart and bought after being selected in it.
EcommerceEnhanced.PromotionsDocumentation: Each internal promotion with its views and clicks, and the items added to cart and bought after it was selected.
EcommerceEnhanced.CouponsDocumentation: Orders and revenue by coupon code. Orders without a coupon are grouped under (not set).
EcommerceEnhanced.PaymentTypesDocumentation: Orders and revenue by payment type, taken from the purchase event or from the payment step of the visit.
EcommerceEnhanced.ShippingTiersDocumentation: Orders and revenue by shipping tier, taken from the purchase event or from the shipping step of the visit.
EcommerceEnhanced.CustomerTypesDocumentation: Orders and revenue of new and returning customers, as declared by the shop with customer_type. Guest checkouts without this information are grouped under (not set).
EcommerceEnhanced.AffiliationsDocumentation: Orders and revenue by affiliation, the store or marketplace the order was placed on.
EcommerceEnhanced.CurrenciesDocumentation: Orders and revenue by order currency. Matomo records the amounts as sent: orders in another currency than the website currency are not converted.
EcommerceEnhanced.ItemsAddedToCartDocumentation: Quantity of items added to cart (add_to_cart).
EcommerceEnhanced.ItemsPurchasedDocumentation: Quantity of items bought in orders.
EcommerceEnhanced.ItemRevenueDocumentation: Price multiplied by quantity of the items bought, without tax and shipping.
EcommerceEnhanced.ListViewsDocumentation: Number of times the item list was displayed (view_item_list).
EcommerceEnhanced.ListClicksDocumentation: Number of times an item was selected in the list (select_item).
EcommerceEnhanced.PromotionViewsDocumentation: Number of times the promotion was displayed (view_promotion).
EcommerceEnhanced.PromotionClicksDocumentation: Number of times the promotion was selected (select_promotion).
EcommerceEnhanced.ItemsInOrdersDocumentation: Number of items in the orders.
EcommerceEnhanced.StepRateDocumentation: Visits of this step divided by the visits of the first step.
EcommerceEnhanced.AbandonmentRateDocumentation: Share of the visits of this step that did not reach the next step.
EcommerceEnhanced.CartToViewRateDocumentation: Items added to cart divided by items viewed.
EcommerceEnhanced.PurchaseToViewRateDocumentation: Items purchased divided by items viewed.
EcommerceEnhanced.ListClickRateDocumentation: List clicks divided by list views.
EcommerceEnhanced.PromotionClickRateDocumentation: Promotion clicks divided by promotion views.
EcommerceEnhanced.TagManagerOptionTitle: Read the GA4 ecommerce dataLayer (Ecommerce Enhanced)
EcommerceEnhanced.TagManagerOptionDescription: Records the GA4, gtag and Universal Analytics ecommerce events pushed to the container data layer (_mtm): product views, carts, checkout steps, orders and refunds. For pushes to window.dataLayer, check "Actively synchronise from the Google Tag Manager data layer" in the container settings. The tracker must be registered as the default tracker.
EcommerceEnhanced.SourceMediumDocumentation: Visits, orders and revenue by source and medium, as in GA4: google / organic, example.com / referral, newsletter / email, (direct) / (none). Campaign source and medium are read from the Marketing Campaigns Reporting plugin when it is installed, otherwise the campaign name is used as the source.
EcommerceEnhanced.ConversionRateDocumentation: Visits with an order divided by visits.
EcommerceEnhanced.ConvertedVisitsDocumentation: Number of visits that placed at least one order.
EcommerceEnhanced.BuyerKpisDocumentation: The GA4 monetization overview: revenue, orders, purchasers, first time purchasers, average revenue per user and per paying user, average order value, ecommerce conversion rate and cart abandonment rate.
EcommerceEnhanced.PurchasersDocumentation: Unique visitors who placed at least one order in the period.
EcommerceEnhanced.FirstTimePurchasersDocumentation: Purchasers who had never ordered before the period, from what Matomo knows of the visitor.
EcommerceEnhanced.CartVisitsDocumentation: Visits that had a cart or placed an order.
EcommerceEnhanced.CartAbandonmentRateDocumentation: Share of the visits with a cart that did not place an order.
EcommerceEnhanced.CustomersHelp: Who your customers are and how they come back: repeat purchases, retention cohorts and lifetime value. Available with Ecommerce Enhanced Premium.
EcommerceEnhanced.TeaserActiveUsersDescription: Users and buyers active over the last 1, 7 and 30 days (DAU, WAU, MAU) and the DAU / MAU stickiness ratio, as in GA4.
EcommerceEnhanced.TeaserFirstUserSourceDescription: Revenue and purchasers by the source that brought each buyer for the first time, to value the channels that start customer journeys.
EcommerceEnhanced.TeaserAbandonedCartsByChannelDescription: Abandoned carts, their value and the abandonment rate by channel type and source / medium.
EcommerceEnhanced.TeaserTimeToPurchaseDescription: Days and visits from the very first visit to the first purchase, by channel.
EcommerceEnhanced.TeaserBehaviorByDeviceAndChannel: Shopping behavior by device and channel
EcommerceEnhanced.TeaserBehaviorByDeviceAndChannelDescript: The shopping and checkout funnels side by side for each device type and channel, to find where each audience drops off.
EcommerceEnhanced.TeaserLeadPipelineDescription: Leads from generate_lead to qualified, converted or disqualified, with their value and conversion rates.
EcommerceEnhanced.TeaserProductAffinityDescription: Market basket analysis: the products most often bought together, with support, confidence and lift.
EcommerceEnhanced.TeaserAbandonedProductsDescription: Products left in abandoned carts, with the quantity and the value lost.
EcommerceEnhanced.TeaserProductProfitDescription: Profit and margin by product, brand and category from the cost of goods you send or import.
EcommerceEnhanced.TeaserCustomItemParametersDescription: A report for each of your item dimensions (size, color, stock status...) with the products viewed, added to cart and bought for each value.
EcommerceEnhanced.TeaserRefundsDescription: Refunded amounts, refund rate by product and net revenue over time, with refunds sent from the dataLayer or from your back office.
EcommerceEnhanced.TeaserDiscountDepthDescription: Discount amount and discount rate by product, coupon and category, and the revenue they generate.
EcommerceEnhanced.TeaserBasketDistribution: Orders by basket size and value
EcommerceEnhanced.TeaserBasketDistributionDescription: How many orders fall in each range of items per order and of order value.
EcommerceEnhanced.TeaserMultiCurrencyDescription: Orders placed in other currencies converted to the website currency with daily exchange rates, so every revenue report adds up.
EcommerceEnhanced.TeaserRepeatPurchaseDescription: Repeat purchase rate, orders per customer and time between two purchases.
EcommerceEnhanced.TeaserRetentionCohortsDescription: Customers grouped by the month of their first purchase, and how many buy again in the following months.
EcommerceEnhanced.TeaserLifetimeValueDescription: Lifetime value by acquisition channel and RFM segments (recency, frequency, monetary value) of your customers.
EcommerceEnhanced.ItemsAddedToWishlistDocumentation: Quantity of items added to a wishlist (add_to_wishlist).
EcommerceEnhanced.CategoriesDocumentation: Each product category, at every level, with the number of times its products were viewed, added to cart and bought, and their revenue. A product counts in each of its categories.
EcommerceEnhanced.SearchesDocumentation: Number of product search result pages (view_search_results).
EcommerceEnhanced.ItemsListedDocumentation: Products shown in the search results.
EcommerceEnhanced.SearchTermsDocumentation: What visitors searched in your shop, how many products the search returned, and how many of those visits placed an order.
EcommerceEnhanced.TransactionsDocumentation: Every order of the period, most recent first, with its revenue, subtotal, tax, shipping, discount and items, and the coupon, payment type, shipping tier, customer type and currency sent with the purchase. At most 500 orders are listed, as in the Ecommerce log.
EcommerceEnhanced.SettingsPageIntro: How this website sends its GA4 ecommerce data and how Matomo records it. Changes apply to the data tracked from now on.
EcommerceEnhanced.SettingsSaved: The Ecommerce Enhanced settings have been saved.
EcommerceEnhanced.ItemDimensionExists: An item dimension named "%1$s" already exists.
EcommerceEnhanced.ItemDimensionNotFound: This item dimension does not exist.
EcommerceEnhanced.ItemDimensionHowToTitle: How to send this item dimension
EcommerceEnhanced.ItemDimensionHowTo: Add the parameter to each item of your GA4 ecommerce pushes, with the name of the dimension as key. Ecommerce Enhanced records it for product views, carts, orders and refunds.
EcommerceEnhanced.TransactionsDisabled: The list of transactions is hidden for this website, as the visitor log is disabled in the privacy settings.
EcommerceEnhanced.SettingStoreCouponCodesHelp: Unchecked, a hash of each coupon code is stored: codes stay distinct in the reports but cannot be read, as single use and gift codes can identify a person or be spent. Check it if your codes are shared promotional codes, such as SUMMER10, you want to read in the reports. Applies to the orders tracked from now on.

OpenmostCommunication.AIChatbotsTitle: Need help setting up AI chatbot tracking?
OpenmostCommunication.AIChatbotsBody: As an official Matomo Implementation Partner, Openmost can configure AI chatbot tracking for you, on Matomo On-Premise or Cloud.
OpenmostCommunication.AIChatbotsCta: Get it set up for me
OpenmostCommunication.TrackingPlanTitle: Events need to be set up manually
OpenmostCommunication.TrackingPlanBody: Events measure clicks, downloads, form submissions or video plays, once they are tracked. As an official Matomo Implementation Partner, Openmost designs and implements a tracking plan that fits your site.
OpenmostCommunication.EventsEnhancedLink: Get more out of your events with Events Enhanced

CustomDimensions.ScopeDescriptionItem: Custom Dimensions in scope 'Item' are custom parameters of the products in your GA4 ecommerce dataLayer, such as size, color or stock status, recorded by Ecommerce Enhanced for each product viewed, added to cart, bought and refunded.
CustomDimensions.ScopeDescriptionItemMoreInfo: The name of the dimension is the parameter key in your items. Renaming a dimension keeps the values recorded before, deactivating it stops recording new values.
